annotation.authors_or_issuer: Idrac, A.-M. (Haute représentante pour le développement de la mobilité routière automatisée et connectée), France
key_provisions_or_claims: Priority for 2025-2027 is scaling from experimentation to deployment of automated road transport services.
Improve safety demonstration and homologation, including validation of AI components, as the final step to generalisation.
Build a European coalition of mobility authorities and propose European projects to mass-produce demand and supply.
Reform the 2018 experimental framework, which no longer fits mature systems.
Facilitate road data exchanges (ITS directive transposition, data space) and develop skills.
annotation.summary_en: French report updating the national strategy for automated and connected road mobility for 2025-2027. It reviews progress, notes the complete regulatory framework built on safety demonstration, and proposes actions to scale deployment: European coalitions, innovation funding, reform of the experimental regime, AI validation, data exchange and skills. It does not bind the government.
annotation.title_clean: Mobilités routières automatisées et connectées : mise à jour de la stratégie nationale – Bilan et propositions de mise à jour
annotation.title_en: Automated and Connected Road Mobility: Update of the National Strategy – Review and Update Proposals
